session.platform: Windows 11, Chromium, RTX 4090 D3D11 hardware WebGL

observations.label: OBSERVED
observations.title: Gauntlets remain planar and procedurally assembled
observations.context: Hip, held ADS, and peak authority-reload frames on Inkfall Rev5
observations.action: Hold the VLR-7 at hip, hold ADS, then trigger an authority reload
observations.expectation: A continuous authored Assault sleeve, gauntlet, wrist seal, and glove silhouette
observations.actual: The v19 arm is connected and tapered, but the bright rectangular dorsal plate and simple cylindrical sleeve remain visibly procedural
observations.playerConsequence: The contact no longer looks broken, but the arm still lowers trust in the intended polished sci-fi presentation
reproduction: Open the source-frozen v19 online capture
Compare screenshots 01-west-spawn-pocket-forward, 01b-vlr7-held-ads, and 01d-vlr7-authority-reload with the same v18 frames
hypotheses: Primitive-only geometry cannot supply the authored curvature and panel transitions expected from a final first-person arm
The dorsal armor is too broad and reflective under Inkfall's cyan lighting
observations.nextDiscriminatingTest: Replace only the visible dorsal shell with one authored low-poly forearm and glove mesh while preserving the proven markers and rerun the same three frames
observations.recommendedOutcome: Keep the v19 connected contact skeleton but replace the visible primitive shells with an authored Assault first-person arm mesh

observations.label: OBSERVED
observations.title: Both arms still move as one rigid weapon presentation assembly
observations.context: Peak authority reload at 45 percent progress
observations.action: Trigger reload and observe the hand, wrist, elbow, and weapon relationship
observations.expectation: The support hand releases or shifts while the trigger hand retains a credible grip and the forearm articulates
observations.actual: The connected arm geometry follows the weapon pose without independent hand release, elbow articulation, or magazine interaction
observations.playerConsequence: Reload state is readable, but it lacks believable body mechanics and will look synthetic in motion
reproduction: Enter the v19 two-player online route with the VLR-7 selected
Fire to reduce ammunition and press R
Inspect the arm chain near 45 percent reload progress
hypotheses: The contact rig is parented to the weapon presentation and has no independent skeletal or procedural limb solver
observations.nextDiscriminatingTest: Add one authored support-hand release and return curve around the existing authority reload phase, then capture a short motion sequence rather than a still
observations.recommendedOutcome: Provide independent dominant/support hand animation while retaining authority-driven reload timing

observations.label: MEASURED
observations.title: Contact continuity and weapon-state integration improved without changing authority
observations.context: Source-frozen v19 hardware capture compared with v18
observations.action: Exercise hip, held ADS, authority fire, authority reload, and linked portal traversal
observations.expectation: Two connected hands remain on the proven VLR-7 contacts through all captured states
observations.actual: The capture reports two hands, the v2 Assault contact mode, held ADS, two accepted attack presentations, one reload presentation, and one linked portal traversal with zero console or page errors
observations.playerConsequence: The revision preserves the working combat loop while removing the most obvious elbow and wrist gaps
reproduction: Run the v19 capture command against clean commit 272d9df
Inspect focused-visual-capture.json and the four weapon-state frames
hypotheses: Overlapping elbow bridges and wrist seals removed the prior single-point discontinuities without altering grip markers
observations.nextDiscriminatingTest: Run the final authored-mesh replacement through the same paired capture
observations.recommendedOutcome: Retain the v19 contact coordinates and authority binding as the animation and mesh foundation
